title: Customer profile - paas_customer
lede: Not hand-drawn. Every frame is the actual ProfileRouteView paas_customer composes - base_sdk's GenericProfilePage with marketplace_sdk's sections registered into it - rendered headlessly by test/render/render_screen_test.dart at 390 logical px / dpr 3. Data is the SDKs' own demo fixtures in a demo session, never a live backend.
